legacy_compatibility.policy: Existing databases are opened without adding the cursor index, regardless of backup status. Only newly created databases receive it. No existing-database index migration is implemented; new indexed databases are not accepted by the 0.4.1 strict schema validator.
legacy_compatibility.test: Synthetic version 2 legacy database, 120 messages, cleanly closed before and after opening. Pagination remained correct; schema signature before and after matched the 0.4.1 expected schema and each other.
legacy_compatibility.previous_validator: The storage_guard.py from git HEAD accepted a separate synthetic version 2 legacy database both before and after current Repository open/close, returning version 2 each time.
legacy_compatibility.hash_note: Database bytes differ after ordinary startup writes; this verifies schema preservation, not a byte-for-byte read-only open. The full database and WAL remain subject to normal backup requirements.

limits: Microbenchmark only; its indexed results apply to newly created databases, not existing databases. No snapshot, end-to-end detail, memory, cold read, concurrent accounts or real data measured.
